FeaturesSection.heading: A feature rich Wood That Lets You Breathe Freely
FeaturesSection.descriptionBold: Indowud nfc is a sustainable eco-friendly panel product for all exterior & interior furnishing and joinery applications.
FeaturesSection.descriptionRegular: It is a zero-wood product, a superior alternative to tropical wood and wood-based panels like plywood, MDF/HDF in many ways.

BenefitsSection.label: Benefits & Craftability
BenefitsSection.heading: Designed for {performance}, made for {imagination}.
copy: Natural wood-like appearance allows it to print, paint, stain, varnish, overlay veneer/laminate, CNC routing, etc.
The high content of natural fibres gives better physical and mechanical properties like product density, strength and screw holding.
Indowud nfc is not plywood, or wood fibre board. Wood fibre boards have wood particles, while nfc board has only agricultural husk.
BenefitsSection.calloutText: Thermoformable for curves and complex geometries—perfect for architects and factories turning imagination into reality.

CertificationsSection.headingLine1: CII has Certified Indowud nfc as Sustainable Green Product
CertificationsSection.headingLine2: and has awarded with GreenPro ecolabel
CertificationsSection.para1: A product which bears GreenPro Ecolabel has lower environment impact and contributes significantly for enhancing the performance of Green Buildings and Green Companies.
CertificationsSection.para2: GreenPro Ecolabel is accredited by Global Ecolabelling Network (GEN) through GENICES – GEN's Internationally Coordinated Ecolabelling System.
CertificationsSection.para3: An Environmental Product Declaration (EPD) is a Type III environmental declaration that quantifies environmental information about the life cycle of a product. It is generally done to understand the environmental impact of the product and demonstrate a commitment to limiting environmental impacts.

ahimsa: Axe the axe, no more trees cut.
Mouldable and easy to design with.
Agricultural husk made, preventing air pollution from waste husk burning.
BrandSection.caption: Philosophy of non-violence and harmony

TrustedProgramsSection.heading: Verified by trusted programs
TrustedProgramsSection.description: From ISO standards to sustainability ecolabels, our panels are audited against rigorous benchmarks for safety, quality and environmental performance.
TrustedProgramsSection.greenproCallout: GreenPro Ecolabel by CII validates lifecycle excellence and green building contribution.
